cited.quote: Advocates Welfare Fund from Rs.5.25 lakh to Rs.7.00 lakh

rationale: C1 (policy note) reports that the Government enhanced the Advocates Welfare Fund assistance from Rs.5.25 lakh to Rs.7.00 lakh, matching the promised 7 lakh. C2 shows the earlier step to Rs.5.25 lakh. No GO date is given, so the date is the document date of C1, an upper bound.

cited.quote: the Government have further enhanced the Ulema Pension from Rs.1000/- to Rs.1500/-Per month

rationale: C1 recounts that the fifth-read GO (No.57, dated 'L7 ,LT.2OL6', read as 17.11.2016, OCR garbled) raised Ulema Pension from Rs.1000/- to Rs.1500/- per month, exactly the promised increase and after the government took office. The 2020 GO later raised it further to Rs.3000/-.

cited.quote: providing financial assistance for Jerusalem Pilgrimage by all sects of Christians in Tamil Nadu is implemented
beneficiaries who are undertaking this Pilgrimage has been enhanced from 500 to 600

rationale: C1 and C3 show the Jerusalem pilgrimage assistance scheme continued through the term, with releases each year (C3 table, 2016-17 onwards) and a GO (No.50, Dt. 31.8.18) increasing beneficiaries from 500 to 600. The date is the first dated GO in C3; continuation began earlier but no earlier dated order is shown.
